name: sc6_phone
goal: Scenario 6, handheld scanner, hands-free: left claw opens wide 5 s for the phone, then everything is automatic: firm gentle grip on the phone; the left arm holds it over the parcel until it scans the label; the harness routes the code (zone); left arm back; WALLX picks the parcel up with the right arm and puts it into that zone; release; both arms home, the left still holding the phone (take it out after the run).
setup: Phone: scanner page open AND 'Start camera' tapped, 3x. Parcel label-up where the demo picked it (right of centre, in front of zone 2's front-left corner). Arms at rest. Put the phone in the left claw during the 5 s it is open; hands off after that.
